[ASSISTANT_SAID] Sweet potato fries are a delicious and healthy snack.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested healthy snack ideas:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Roasted Chickpeas: Rinse and dry a can of chickpeas, toss with olive oil and seasonings, roast at 400°F (200°C) for 30-40 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Air-Popped Popcorn: Season with herbs, spices, or olive oil.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Trail Mix: Mix nuts, seeds, and dried fruits.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Veggie Sticks with Hummus: Carrots, cucumbers, and bell peppers with hummus.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Energy Balls: Mix rolled oats, nuts, seeds, dried fruits, honey, and peanut butter.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Edamame: Boil or steam and season with sea salt.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Kale Chips: Bake kale leaves with olive oil and seasonings.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Fresh Fruit Infused Water: Add slices of fruits to water.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 9. Yogurt Parfait: Layer Greek yogurt with berries, granola, and honey.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 10. Spicy Roasted Pumpkin Seeds: Toss with olive oil, salt, and spices, roast at 350°F (175°C) for 30-40 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for getting roasted chickpeas extra crispy:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Dry the chickpeas with a paper towel.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Roast at 425°F (220°C) for 30-40 minutes.
